tooltip.essentialcraft5.computer_helmet.en: Never hungry or out of breath; %s toggles night vision
tooltip.essentialcraft5.computer_helmet.zh: 饥饿值和氧气不会耗尽；按 %s 开关夜视

tooltip.essentialcraft5.computer_chestpl.en: Immune to plain magic damage (poison, corruption and the like), wither and starvation
tooltip.essentialcraft5.computer_chestpl.zh: 免疫普通魔法伤害（中毒、腐化这类）、凋零和饥饿伤害

tooltip.essentialcraft5.computer_legging.en: Faster movement and higher jumps; fire resistance while burning
tooltip.essentialcraft5.computer_legging.zh: 移动更快、跳得更高；着火时获得抗火

tooltip.essentialcraft5.computer_boots.en: No fall damage; steps up full blocks
tooltip.essentialcraft5.computer_boots.zh: 免疫摔落伤害；能直接迈上一格高的方块

tooltip.essentialcraft5.computer_armor.s.en: While charged, blocks its share of any damage that does not bypass armor (%s MRU per point)
tooltip.essentialcraft5.computer_armor.s.zh: 有电时挡下所有不无视护甲的伤害里它那一份（每点 %s MRU）

tooltip.essentialcraft5.computer_armor.s.en: While charged, blocks its share of physical and elemental damage (%s MRU per point)
tooltip.essentialcraft5.computer_armor.s.zh: 有电时挡下物理和元素伤害里它那一份（每点 %s MRU）

tooltip.essentialcraft5.computer_armor.s.en: While charged, blocks its share of melee and projectile damage (%s MRU per point)
tooltip.essentialcraft5.computer_armor.s.zh: 有电时挡下近战和弹射物伤害里它那一份（每点 %s MRU）

tooltip.essentialcraft5.computer_armor.f.en: - Returns %s of melee, projectile and explosion damage to the attacker
tooltip.essentialcraft5.computer_armor.f.zh: - 把挨到的近战、弹射物、爆炸伤害的 %s 反给攻击者

tooltip.essentialcraft5.computer_armor.f.en: - %s: boost toward where you look; swim much faster
tooltip.essentialcraft5.computer_armor.f.zh: - 按 %s 朝视线方向喷射推进；游得快得多

message.essentialcraft5.computer_seal.no.en: Curio Seal Field is out of power and stopped (needs %s MRU per second)

message.essentialcraft5.computer_seal.di.zh: 饰品封禁场在这个世界里不起作用，离开这里就恢复

message.essentialcraft5.curio_seal.first.zh: 你的饰品暂时失效：%s 的饰品封禁场。离开他 %s 格以外，或等他关掉，就恢复。

message.essentialcraft5.curio_seal.seale.en: Your curios are sealed by %s's Curio Seal Field

tooltip.essentialcraft5.curio_seal.seale.zh: 被饰品封禁场压制：效果暂时失效
